task_description: Grouped matmul: 8 row-blocks of a (128, 64) input, each multiplied by one of 4 (64, 64) weight matrices selected by a per-block group_id array. Whole weight tensor VMEM-resident versus scalar-prefetch-driven index_map.

metrics.name: vmem_resident_weight_elems
metrics.description: Weight-tensor elements resident in VMEM per grid step: G*K*N when every candidate is resident, K*N when only the selected slice is fetched via scalar prefetch. Scales with G.

metrics.name: achieved_tflops_pct_of_peak_bf16
metrics.description: Achieved TFLOPS as a percentage of v5e peak bf16 TFLOPS (197.0). Secondary signal.

notes: Uses pltpu.PrefetchScalarGridSpec; see guide.md for the argument ordering convention.
